Time elapsed since 2026-03-02 (Lipid panel follow-up) and 2026-01-14 (Hypertension review). No interim events were described in the current transcript.

Last plan recap: Atorvastatin 20 mg nocte was started for LDL 3.9 mmol/L on 2026-03-02; salt restriction and follow-up in three months were advised on 2026-01-14.

The patient presented with shortness of breath on exertion and intermittent chest pain over the past two weeks.

General Exam: Heart rate is 88 and regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally.

Ordering an electrocardiogram and a troponin level.

A differential diagnosis includes stable angina. Aspirin 81 milligrams daily was started.

No new findings or complications were reported in the current transcript.

Counseling provided regarding the new investigations and aspirin initiation.
